title: THE MAGNET LEAVES EVENT REWARDS AND PARTY BOXES ALONE
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15, finding 9, checked against the code. The magnet power-up pulled every body, bot wreck and cache within 520 toward you through walls and fences. The stronghold cache, the convoy crate and the golden hoard are caches, so they slid out of a sealed stronghold to whoever stood at the fence; and in a party each window moved its own copy of a box, so the host answered far to a search of a box the other player saw at his feet. The magnet leaves the reward boxes of events where the event put them, and in a party it moves no boxes; it still pulls the pickups on the ground and, alone, the plain bodies.
now: The magnet no longer drags event rewards, and moves no boxes in a party.
